reviews.text: Pleasant and knowledgeable, good cat skills!
Very good animal clinic with friendly doctors and assistants, and very experienced veterinarians.
A fine and reliable clinic. Dedicated and skilled; the doctors and staff make and take the time to treat the animal and to inform and guide the owner.
Friendly, efficient & professional.
Our cats are always wonderfully cared for and we receive good advice.

Had an excellent consultation today. Very clear and informative. After some bad experiences with other vets, we came here on recommendation. Not a chain, but just two skilled veterinarians in their own practice.
Fast service. Very friendly. Too bad the waiting room was cold and dreary.
Very good doctor
Wonderful people. Friendly and professional. Highly recommend!

Because our vet was on vacation, I took my dog ​​to the IJhavens Veterinary Clinic. The vet was friendly but unfortunately didn't have the space to x-ray larger dogs.
We were given painkillers, but unfortunately, she couldn't make a diagnosis.
Quick appointments, friendly doctors. My cats enjoys being there!
Very friendly vet. Our Labradoodle always wants to come in! We live above the clinic, and our dog wants to come in every time!

Brilliant! Helpful, flexible and not very expensive vet. I work with dogs and even in emergencies I have had so many other vets refuse just simple lab tests, prescriptions etc because the dog in need isn’t a usual patient and they don’t accept new ones, even if it it would have taken 5 min of their time. And this clinic is so friendly and helpful I can’t even explain, endlessly grateful for all the support and help they’ve provided over the years. Couldn’t recommend more, this is clearly people that love animals more than they love following unnecessary rules.
Always ready to help when needed. Very kind and skilled.
They've been great so far, knowledgeable and amicable.

Professional, friendly, compassionate, and most of the time easily accessible and fast to respond (also via phone and email). Prices are also still pretty reasonable compared to other larger chain owned places. They are also good with fearful and anxious dogs.
The sweetest veterinarians in Amsterdam. Janine and Bauke care for our pets as if they were our own, with all their expertise and professionalism. Thank you!
Very satisfied with Bauke and the staff. A very nice practice with empathetic, friendly, and professional people.
Passionate veterinarian with extensive knowledge of cats. Probably for dogs too, but I cannot judge that.
Super friendly
Very positive and friendly towards the dog.
Friendly and helpful. Accommodated quickly for an emergency visit.
Best knows
